designBrief: Polished commercial bistro at AA Centre, Alexandra, Singapore, also doubling as an events/party venue. Palette from the business's own real red counter/chairs and marketing graphics (near-black, bold red, warm gold/amber, off-white). Oswald (condensed, confident, sign-painter lineage matching their own bold title-card marketing style) for headings, Work Sans for body. Single-page, photography-led, bolder color-blocking than a quiet-cafe template. Signature element: a string-of-lights motif referencing a real fairy-light terrace photo, used as a section divider with a restrained twinkle animation.
